root_cause: The terminalizer wrote LINEAGE_MODE to GITHUB_ENV and then read it from Node later in the same shell step, where GitHub had not yet applied that environment update. The materialization step also assigned LIVE_BEWEZEN before validating every evidence check and only asserted learning_projection, so merged_lineage_verified=false could coexist with a successful workflow.
prevention_rule: Same-step proof values must be passed directly to the consuming process. Terminal status may become LIVE_BEWEZEN only after every required evidence check evaluates true; any false check must fail the terminalizer hard.
